NFL DFS Projections Week 7: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 24, 5:35 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate: 30.3 DraftKings points at $9,800. He holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations. Christian McCaffrey holds the largest share at 36% for $7,600.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Bijan Robinson (27.1, $8,500), Puka Nacua (23.7, $8,400), Christian McCaffrey (22.6, $7,600) and Kyren Williams (21.3, $7,000). Bijan Robinson returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.19 projected points per $1,000. Puka Nacua leads the wide receivers at 23.7 for $8,400, Jared Goff leads the quarterbacks at 19.9 for $6,800, and George Kittle leads the tight ends at 17.0 for $5,700.

The 10-game slate runs from a 53.5-point total in GB at DET down to 36.5 in CLE at TEN. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 24, 5:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 7 DraftKings projections

Jared Goff, DET vs GB ($6,800)

Jared Goff carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 19.9 DraftKings points at $6,800. That is 0.2 points clear of C.J. Stroud. The salary works out to 2.93 projected points per $1,000, 13th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 20.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.1 and a ceiling of 36.4, and he holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 53.5.

C.J. Stroud, HOU vs NYG ($5,700)

C.J. Stroud projects 2nd at the position with 19.7 DraftKings points at $5,700. The salary works out to 3.46 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Stroud averaged 19.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 36.2, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 10-point favorite at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 26.25 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Tyler Huntley, BAL vs CIN ($4,900)

Tyler Huntley projects for 17.9 DraftKings points at $4,900, which works out to 3.64 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 17 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.5 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Huntley averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 33.0, and he holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 23 in a game totaled at 47.5.
